change: Allow at most one explicitly listed non-transfer ROM read: instruction PC transfer+2 (DBRA), address exit+2, fullword mask, pinned ROM value, only after all count*width reads and writes. Never permit an unmodeled write. Do not infer prefetch as a fact from a generic tap.
expectations: Copied-memory/full-register/CCR unchanged; excluded read recorded. Reanalysis of preserved trace, not a new commercial run or independent blind test.
